title: Const all the way through
hints: Two things need fixing: the **signature** (both the parameter and the return type become `const char *`) and the **logic** (remember the position of the last `'.'` you've seen).
Keep a `const char *dot = NULL;` and walk a `const char *p` over the string. Every time `*p == '.'`, set `dot = p`. At the end, return `NULL` if `dot` is still `NULL`, otherwise `dot + 1`.
`const char *file_extension(const char *path) { const char *dot = NULL; for (const char *p = path; *p != '\0'; p++) { if (*p == '.') dot = p; } return dot ? dot + 1 : NULL; }`
